| | **NEGOP - Staying engaged** **Summer is coming to an end; we have already begun to see many Back to School pictures posted on social media. As I write this, I am en route to Chicago, IL, returning our youngest to Moody Bible College for his 2nd year. From preschool, to college, to the education and certification of our future educators, the NEGOP is committed to fighting for the rights of children, educators, families, and young adults across Nebraska. We support & promote common sense legislation. ** **The NEGOP is committed to coming alongside other organizations & elected officials who share this common value. This last week, I and many other NEGOP members from across the state attended the Protect Nebraska Children-PAC's dinner & fundraiser. The dinner was delicious and the MCs were our 3 Republican SBOE Members: Kirk Penner, Sherry Jones and Elizabeth Tegtmeier. They were a hit! ** **We appreciate all that the PNC-PAC has done to support conservative Nebraska candidates (local, regional & statewide). They provide essential information to concerned Nebraskans, and aid in the mobilization of citizenry and resources to impact educational leadership. Thank you to the State Legislators who were in attendance. They are showing they are committed to these values. Present were Senators Kathleen Kauth, Steve Erdman, Mike Jacobson, Lou Ann Linehan. Sending their support via pre-recorded video messages were Senators Steve Halloran and John Lowe. Senator Rob Clements was unable to attend, but made his presence via table sponsorship. Other State Elected Officials in attendance were Public Service Commissioner Kevin Stocker and Board of Regent Kathy Wilmot. ** **Sen Kauth reported Sports and Spaces will be back as her PRIORITY bill next session. She asks for everyone's help encouraging each senator to vote FOR it. One step at a time, we will continue to push for the rights and safety of our children. ** **WINNING - As has been reported, LB 574 stood up to a lawsuit from the ACLU. We expect the ACLU to continue to waste tax-payer dollars in an attempt to stop this. Sen Kauth stated, "The decision was written in very strong language that will make it very hard to defeat. They may well come up with other rationales to try to sue. But for now, we celebrate the victory!"** **As we approach the last quarter of 2023, many State Legislators and their teams are hard at work preparing for 2024 to take care of unfinished business. The Legislative sub-committees of the NEGOP are revving up to assist our Senators and their Legislative Aids in finishing the business they started this year; a few of them have been meeting now for several weeks - researching, discussing and game planning for 2024.** **Pressing On,** **William Feely** ******Legislative Director** **negop.legislative@gmail.com**

body:
Help a real conservative qualify for the debates! | | | | | [](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=4b8a8e2d28&e=2798306028)

Friend,

**What happened to decency in our country?** What happened to respect for different points of view? Last month at the Turning Point Conference, while the students tried to listen, I was booed by the adult crowd of Pro-Trump supporters.

They acted like an out-of-control mob and wanted to shut down my speech before I could even offer my vision to bring out the best in America. **When Republicans act like this we are no better than radical liberal Democrats who protest conservative speaking at Universities.**

A real leader would push back on his supporters to at least act with dignity and respect but **Trump vocally encourages this type of outrageous behavior.**

If you think we need to bring decency back to our country**,**[**support our campaign for President with a contribution**](https://asa2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=803b747a2e50e008bc15a2eaf&id=b7576c8051&e=2798306028)**.** America deserves a real leader who will stand up to Trump's juvenvile behavior.

Hello,
In 2022, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
Since then, a lot of people have asked me how we came so close to defeating Boebert when all of the political “experts” said we had no chance.
We spent _a lot_ of time on the road. During the last campaign, my son Felix and I drove 24,000 miles in our red pickup truck, meeting with voters wherever we found them. In restaurants and breweries. In living rooms and backyards. And on farms and ranches.
But Lauren Boebert just plain outspent us. She started earlier, and she started with a lot more money. And her corporate PAC friends were there for her, writing huge checks every time she had a fundraising deadline. We just couldn’t compete with her millions.
So this time, we’re starting early. I’m already back in the truck with Felix. We’re drawing bigger and bigger crowds and seeing lots of familiar faces – and getting introduced to even more new people who are ready to join our campaign.
And we’re actually _out-raising_ Lauren Boebert with the help of grassroots donors like you. But Boebert’s allies are coming to her rescue. One Super PAC says they’re planning to put $20 million into just three or four House races – and Boebert’s one of them.
With all due respect to the national party, we ran this race without one dime of support last time – and I’m not expecting a penny more than that this time. People can call me naive if they want, but I believe we can finish the job and defeat Lauren Boebert in 2024. For our democracy, I believe we _must_.
I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. I don’t have a Super PAC promising to spend millions to help me win. And I’m not getting financial support from the party bosses in Washington. **If we’re going to defeat Lauren Boebert and finally restore some sanity to Washington, I’m counting entirely on grassroots donors like you to give right now:**
[**Please, will you chip in $5 or more right now to my campaign – every dollar you can afford to spare today – and help me defeat Lauren Boebert? This campaign is 100% funded by people like you, so no amount is too small.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68260018/422471787/1610638071?refcode=em20230817pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=1277d02e-5d3d-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjc3ZDAyZS01ZDNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xtqhSumLlxa5BOVLSTOYPjHj-rHhgTrMe0J-WJ8bFNs=)

Hello, In 2022, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country. During the last campaign, my son Felix and I drove 24,000 miles in our red pickup truck, meeting with voters wherever we found them. In restaurants and breweries. In living rooms and backyards. And on farms and ranches. But Lauren Boebert just plain outspent us. She started earlier, and she started with a lot more money. And her corporate PAC friends were there for her, writing huge checks every time she had a fundraising deadline. We just couldn’t compete with her millions. So this time, we’re starting early. I’m already back in the truck with Felix. We’re drawing bigger and bigger crowds and seeing lots of familiar faces – and getting introduced to even more new people who are ready to join our campaign. And we’re actually out-raising Lauren Boebert with the help of grassroots donors like you. But Boebert’s allies are coming to her rescue. One Super PAC says they’re planning to put $20 million into just three or four House races – and Boebert’s one of them. With all due respect to the national party, we ran this race without one dime of support last time – and I’m not expecting a penny more than that this time. People can call me naive if they want, but I believe we can finish the job and defeat Lauren Boebert in 2024. For our democracy, I believe we must. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs. Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

name: Sara Jacobs
subject: What the Ohio election results mean for the future of abortion access in America
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends,
By now, you’ve likely heard the news that, just last week, Ohioans rejected - by a huge margin - a ballot measure that would’ve made it harder to pass a Constitutional amendment.
The election was seen as a proxy for abortion rights - Democrats were working on a Constitutional amendment to codify reproductive rights this November, and in response, Ohio Republicans rushed this special election to put obstacles in their way.
The people of Ohio stood up and sent a powerful message that they won’t allow the GOP to further restrict their freedoms.
This election has deep significance for the future of abortion access in our country - for one thing, it’s proof that Americans across the political spectrum won’t tolerate infringements on our foundational freedoms like bodily autonomy.
For another, it’s a powerful and important reminder that abortion is a kitchen table issue !
But still - there are too many places in our country where abortion access has already been decimated, so we must take action in Congress.
If I’m re-elected and Democrats win back the House of Representatives in 2024, I can promise I’ll do everything in my power to codify the protections of Roe v. Wade at the federal level. But I need your help: Can you pitch in $25 or more to my re-election campaign to make sure I can hold onto my seat and support other Democrats running in key districts next year? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately.
Donate $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=5]
Donate $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=10]
Donate $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=20]
Donate other amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Look, the Midwest has trended toward the GOP over the last ten years. But if a state like Ohio can stand up so strongly for abortion rights, just think of what that could mean for the upcoming election in 2024.
We need to press our advantage and send a message to the Republicans in Congress that when you mess with our freedoms, you won’t get re-elected - and you certainly won’t get to maintain your majority.
Thanks for your support,
-Sara

body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Friend --

My name is Morgan Luttrell.

I'm a combat veteran who served in multiple combat
missions in defense of America.

I've seen things I wouldn't wish on my worst enemy.
Things I will never be able to unsee.

In 2009, I survived a helicopter crash that
should've taken my life but, by the grace of God, I was given a
second chance.

No matter how tough or brave you are, nothing is
fully in your control. That's why we put our faith in God.

But -- there are some things we CAN control, and
that's why I'm running for Congress.

I have to just say it: Biden and the Radical
Democrats want me GONE, they want me DEFEATED, they want to END
my campaign for good.

But unlike the spineless career politicians, I'm
not someone who EVER gives up.

You see, the career DC politicians are living each
day by their own agenda -- not thinking about those suffering the
consequences.

After my time in the military, I knew that each day
that I woke up in America was a gift.

The land of the free and home of the brave.

But the Biden regime has stripped our nation of our
core values and turned us down a path that is leading us toward a
dark future.

So, Friend, I want to humbly ask you right now if
you'll stand with me in my fight for the America we all once knew
and loved.

It is patriots like yourself that have helped
change the direction of our country before, but we still need
you. Maybe now more than ever.

Please, stand up for America's liberties and
freedoms by chipping in just a few bucks today?

CONTRIBUTE

Together, we can bring America back to her
greatness before the Democrats send us further down the dark path
we're currently on.

Thank you,

Morgan Luttrell

name: Larry Kudlow
subject: The New York Sun is saving journalism
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
[](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
Dear Fellow American, **I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.**

**I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.**

But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.
**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. **Joining the Sun costs as little as $0.01 per day.** I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.
---
[**Join the Sun Now →**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
**Please join me in the fight to restore America's journalism.**** ** This is one mission that our country desperately needs.
---
---
**Larry Kudlow** Columnist for The New York Sun

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...

This won't be easy and will require a mountain of evidence to be presented quickly. If we don't move soon, Biden and his criminal cronies will steal another election by locking up their opponent, among other criminal dirty tricks!

This is outrageous; my friend, I've seen it all.

**[Will you help us move quickly to start our investigations?](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zips6sqlhrrkvf8noqt1b2p1rguib2j95nljn7j0_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphmcor1c3h2bs)**

And now, I'm taking on the most egregious abuse of power by an evil President willing to fabricate crimes to imprison his political opposition.

This is both our future and our past . . . and it is sick and more importantly dangerous!

During the Civil Rights movement, you may recall racist Dixicrat leaders who repeatedly fabricated charges against men like Martin Luther King, Jr. to lock up outspoken activists.

And like today, they used the corrupt FBI to collect dirt on everyone who challenged them.

Let's face it. Our government is corrupt to the core, and it will take the efforts of the citizens of America to clean house and set things right. This can't happen with elections - because those in power manipulate our elections - and now, in the most obscene ways! By imprisoning the opposition!

We must use the People's Court of Justice to accomplish our vital mission.

**[Your strong financial support is vital to help us begin this work!](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zpdaso3qiolgsnrfro3je6alav63qo5d6vsqbr70_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphmcor1c3h2bs)**

Are you in? If not, you will have abandoned you and your loved ones who will be forced to live in the socialist and atheist hellhole foisted upon us by Joe Biden and his commie and other subversive friends and colleagues.

As a communist, Biden is godless; and as one example he pushes the killing of the unborn, and sexual perversion on our children. He not a Catholic as he claims, but instead a rabid leftist dictator and predator who knows no bounds of Judeo-Christian morality. He is a master criminal who must be legally brought down and sent to prison where he can spend his last miserable days alone in a cellblock!

**[Donate today and help Freedom Watch investigate, charge, try, convict, have arrested this disciple of the devil Joe Biden!](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zs7glashj0d44hug8vqnvuos2qpgq6n7gcbe6ito_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphmcor1c3h2bs)**

Thanks for all that you do and please strongly support Freedom Watch in its quest to legally bring Joe Biden to justice before We the People.

In the Name of Justice and the Preservation of Our Freedom and Liberty,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

subject: Former Home Depot CEO issues dire warning for Americans
body:
Something strange is happening in our financial system.

| Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy’s are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning:
> "We’re going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years..."
What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she’s found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. All it takes is one look at this troubling chart to see why - [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1s1ti7ak1lcretn9qb5ded9ihanl3ekr6n1e6fo_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphmcor6cth2bs) Dr. Prins says:
> ** "This chart tells you everything you need to know about the next crisis in America. In short, what we’re about to see is a currency crisis - but not the kind of currency crisis most folks expect. This firm - along with many others - will almost certainly go bankrupt as a result." **
According to Dr. Prins, our money is about to change forever... and the overhaul is set to happen in just a few weeks. To help folks prepare, she’s recorded a briefing that explains all the details of what she calls a 'reset' to our financial system. In it, she lays out all the evidence of this currency crisis, and what you can do to prepare. [Click here now to see her full (and free) presentation.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zaj7hc3np2j3a48ftqnrflu7a00ebk289f04agr0_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphmcor6cth2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura
Senior Managing Editor, Rogue Economics **P.S.** The last time we saw a similar transformations to our money, folks who failed to prepare were blindsided. body:
If you've been to a concert venue, stadium, or airport, you've almost certainly walked by one without knowing.

| **Reverse 'money machines' popping up across America** Machines like the ones in this picture are popping up all across America. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zef4f8sh2e27r37imk3snvdmklf8mi5ggh8e10a8_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphm2pb6cdh2bs) If you've been to a concert venue, stadium, or airport, you've almost certainly walked by one without knowing. The experts are calling it a **'Reverse ATM'** They've been installed at places like Citizen's Bank Ballpark in Philadelphia... They've even been used at the Super Bowl. Why are these machines suddenly appearing out of nowhere? And what does it mean for your money? We've recently arranged an interview with former Goldman Sachs managing director, Dr. Nomi Prins, to get her take. There's nobody in America who's more aware of the inner workings of the banking system. In the interview, **[Dr. Prins explained these strange'reverse ATMs.'](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkgtoo6qu567qauk3k6i5puac3ec4ifhhuaseo3g_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphm2pb6cdh2bs)** And she said she expects them to play a key role this Summer as our nation's financial system is overhauled for the first time since 1971. According to her research, many Americans will be blindsided by what's to come. BUT, folks who understand the 'Reverse ATM' phenomenon before it becomes obvious to the average American could actually profit in the weeks ahead. To help folks prepare, she's recorded a briefing that explains exactly what she sees coming, how it will play out, and **how much time you have to prepare.** **[Click here now to see Dr. Prins' free presentation.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zbhet82dg7mb793c7hfgss7h9qc7ke7qnnmes108_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphm2pb6cdh2bs)**

## Space Force Takes Aim at Enemy Satellites
The U.S. Space Force has activated a unit that targets [other nations' satellites](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL_GbCD7jMEZPFSq2NK1IzL2mVwFOLUvQf37qpm7PekNT3qf1_nqaaNj_fA7Ok559oHpibO0rbIt6Bma6BIioG7QqeEC2oxWmebmbJS-N5B6AC_NskiLyQ56UUscRhVMQw4kaGmVlRc9aujUxQQ0FqJVvdTKi15iJM6l-8p08A3T9pOfWLqQ92ZzN-Z7FfpNwCRgOs-zq3cf8M8KmF7cplwCtqpyy76syHSsbf1--FjyIfT04H2u-VECCv1-ZKZEwTPloyku3k_aNqrDKHq57p62V5f_3_AbAAD__97NX-k) and the ground stations that support them. It's the first and only unit with that mission. The unit will be based out of Colorado's Peterson Space Force Base and already has its own patch: [a grim reaper with a delta shape for a nose.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFyrSAUgOHVYIcDBxUsKF5Dd1-b0iFwVBIUB06uc3efSeps4J9_vrfH8vApp3P77w-0tJbFB0pPXITh0nBQC3TRroiAqkMrpxnUqI0cu93qsI4T6BDNux8H0ChmBYPxMc6THMzaJQsClDDSiFlpBb2cx4CjgWjkIJT0bBAYE5Xaf5R00o5rfpUn1j6Uo8t2J7oaU_8YOAbuvu9-2334bP2JxMD9xBk4YRg4qRm4dvmAfC01IA8VPWHjJ97860zEqXDydUPieOLx4s0T5pwIGwPXVRuvO-Wc2qTZILbDp_x7QX-jfAcAAP__-eBh5g) The mission also includes counter-defense to protect U.S. satellites. The unit will be armed with a mix of ground-based lasers, signal-jamming devices, and cyberattack tools.
## GOP Seeks Biden Emails from Archives
Rep. James Comer is demanding that the National Archives send Congress [unredacted emails to or from then-Vice President Joe Biden](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGP4yAQRn-N3WHBYGJcUFzjLtdeaU1gHM8thghIvPvvV9l66-_T09P7d12vyJHT_S8e5NqWV_SNX7RKK5QVoFfog9uIgHRPTl1m0GayyvS7GxUGhGBmo0dvZzOHDUfQN4VmClZjzw4kaGmVlbOeNAxqNp6MhWDVKLXCbpQUuOUy_M-c2k5b_MovKoPPRx_d3tqjdvpPB0sHy3mew5Y_E531vXewPHLkxr52sPh8UBGBDkyhioSNc8IosPidX1TFlsuHeKPFMxUK6BsFQQdyrGJ_pkZF3DhQErdn4XpgX1x4nBwj18vUjfL-vv5otd8rfQcAAP__1KNsSw) and his son Hunter related to Ukraine and the Burisma energy firm. The existence of a National Archive file containing the emails was made public in June and included four emails, but two were withheld, and the other two were heavily redacted. Comer has also requested unredacted records in which President Biden [used a pseudonym](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyM0DFv8yAYBOBfgzcieDGGDAzfwpZv7WhheB1TYbCAJPK_r9KtUofOp3uku4_bfHMxxXz_73Y0fS2z8z0-cWaack1BzDAEsyICigENn64gpNJcDpvh0yI5E4uWaln8FLzEaVQeFz_KFZQYogEGgmmu2VUoARd-lR6lhqD5yAR3ZGQYYi_18lli7huu6SxPrBdf9iGZrfejEfGPgCVg83mU1t8RAfuGCVimCViuCFhfdqw04O5yaLSiLzU0Wla6xICZPlrMd3o0fISSz52-tpiQPo-ftUeuGJzvGP4uELBDNeF4xZRimxQZ2X13MX1v6L9f-hUAAP__1jV6Qg) during his vice presidency. Hunter Biden's abandoned laptop showed that his father sometimes used the email alias Robert.L.Peters while he was VP.
## San Francisco Wants to Halt Robotaxis
San Francisco officials want state regulators to suspend last week's decision to allow driverless taxi service 24/7 in the city following [a series of traffic snafus](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAQQL8Gb2fBEcd48JDFW7p2tAg-kmsxWEDs5u-rdO749Jan93mdr5YDx_uHXWmsPs3WVd5plgaUAdQzNsvoiZB0Q6M6D6i73qiueYz-piw6PyhrHHpCd_N4M4vu9KB7JanhESVqaZSRg-41tmroHHUGF6NOUisrTpIWrim3X4ljfZAPr7RTbl1amzA-at2K0BeBk8DpOI52LfHtBE4U4VkETjXbnYLAKdLx5mIj-Gyj4-ISJO_ZsQ0FbPmGmqDUtMGzECQPS-adcqBSoNofLsARHNeXwMlmuFyU3zZlmjwu28EhcDn34iTvq-XwF1j___UbAAD__7kWbck) involving the robotaxis. In one case, a driverless vehicle got stuck after [driving into wet concrete](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGnwRsWHHaAgaGLt3TtaJHjHNMS24JLrL591c6d_-GXvo_rfI255O3-Hh8UeNnniJxfNCsntZNgZuhSWIiATEdBXzyY0To9dmtAqwx5f1MINrqYLBm8-YR6wXRLKnU5gAKjnHbKG2ug135EGh0kpwdldBSDopR5r_3nnjdeaSnf-4tqj_ujK2FlPpowbwImAdN5nn1b7pHpNwuYmHAVMMXKGQsJmLA-cyPZ-Ilf8iSWuG9YiUm2RWoH3vrh0h_r0dWQjjOXktvFikHdHzGXvyn_b_ATAAD__yysXdg). In another, a slew of robotaxis stalled in North Beach, blocking traffic. The problem was blamed on "wireless connectivity issues." Last week the California Public Utilities Commission gave permission for robotaxi operators to expand their presence. SF's city attorney now says [the city will suffer "serious harms"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL3O3CAQAJ8Gd5xgsc-4oEhDd2lTWni9Pm-EwQLu7-2jS_3VI41G8-c23wJHTvff4SDXtjwHbPykWVmprQQzQ7e6jQjIdOT0dQIzjFYP3e6mTYcRSMOAy2KttqtdeqsQtnVCfV06dqDAKKutmsxo4KKnAWmwsFrdK6OD6BWt3HK5_M2c2k5b_OQnlQvmo4tub-2swvwS4AX4RrhjeSTcv1iA_8oFeGUFeD0K8DUkuZWQkCtmeRaqlarE84GyZbmH2OQrfI4ssTy4kix5yS28WdL7DKlyTlWA74pbzxfHyPU6il7dj8Dxf1H7edC_AAAA__9ObWdR) if the driverless cars aren't reined in.

| | Hi friend- Over the last week, I have had the amazing opportunity to meet people all around our community. Listening to the concerns of voters firsthand is the only way to understand the most pressing issues you face, and I am truly grateful for the variety of thoughts you shared. It is clear from my travels around our district that one issue, specifically, has been top of mind for many. **I’m talking about supporting our veterans. ** America’s brave service members deserve every form of support we can provide. That’s why I have worked throughout my time in the House of Delegates to support our veterans, and it is why I will never stop working for them if I am elected to another term in office. In Richmond, I:
* Proudly co-sponsored legislation to end taxes on military retirement benefits
* Supported the Veteran’s Promise initiative, which helps Vets who learned skills during their service more easily transition to similar jobs in civilian life.

But this is only the beginning - our veterans deserve much, much more. Virginia can and must be a haven for all former service members. They are our GREATEST RESOURCE, and if we provide the opportunity, I have no doubt they will help our entire Commonwealth grow into a better place to live for everyone. I’ll never stop working on behalf of veterans in our community, but I need your help. [Would you consider giving $5, $10, or $20 to my campaign](http://sendpatriot.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/7383f87aac189526/baa8e0fb875808d1c3d6b838967d376c/37923) so I can continue this important work? It is clear from my travels around our district that one issue, specifically, has been top of mind for many. I’m talking about supporting our veterans. America’s brave service members deserve every form of support we can provide. That’s why I have worked throughout my time in the House of Delegates to support our veterans, and it is why I will never stop working for them if I am elected to another term in office. In Richmond, I: Proudly co-sponsored legislation to end taxes on military retirement benefits Supported the Veteran’s Promise initiative, which helps Vets who learned skills during their service more easily transition to similar jobs in civilian life. But this is only the beginning - our veterans deserve much, much more. Virginia can and must be a haven for all former service members. They are our GREATEST RESOURCE, and if we provide the opportunity, I have no doubt they will help our entire Commonwealth grow into a better place to live for everyone. I’ll never stop working on behalf of veterans in our community, but I need your help. so I can continue this important work? Our veterans deserve nothing but the best, and I’m committed to do whatever it takes to have their back! Sincerely, | | | Delegate Karen S. body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=8790c423677b4bccbdd85578d62be925&_e=Ht0upVd0tK_dLVL7yBPL0W3hq_igOjFy5pyZQaPj03ATODk47UHuWdptsLeR5ZzMI0l6vfJCGfDvt3fVfcxnCHzbwkzHK-Lszdt0wRe9MWJZVkKomXkM_7h5k2n300GPWwAWoUzOeExhy8dzif1lUWPuDbwNjfV2v2ppzbrzY2EM6_PSNNDgmL8HqDNbmI40r3fPsnl1cCznfyHV8y4Y4aNFx3r7Sx7tDIJHiK2Sph--JQI1hcAc4rJc0fWmwHtbcUuIjdFr3kLoAkM7zCHuNOV7pHWYcetNLHgJeKS0Q8wHhmopj7AloHr7-u2sH8-cxAGh-e7Smju1rWSfZy1SAXQtEEdJX4WAkLHndLST6C6yytr6UQk5XhElHDn3F2MXT-doBpyWwFuXSdwxfQEMbzBuVtP9WAcGjqD305ydEpM%3D)

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

subject: Former Home Depot CEO issues dire warning for Americans
body:
Something strange is happening in our financial system.

| Dear Reader, Something strange is happening in our financial system. According to analysts at UBS, more than 50,000 retail locations could shut their doors in the months ahead. Already, Walmart, Foot Locker, Bed Bath & Beyond, and Macy’s are cutting stores. And former Home Depot CEO Bob Nardelli recently issued a grim warning:
> "We’re going to see a lot of bankruptcies. [This is] different than anything I have seen in my 52 years..."
What does it all mean for your family and your money? Dr. Nomi Prins has dug deeper into the research, and she’s found something startling. Amid all the turmoil predicted by Nardeni and UBS, Prins has found a single firm that could be the canary in the coal mine foreshadowing the next major crisis in America. All it takes is one look at this troubling chart to see why - [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zomoet5ndo49rp1cua8mo5do8tkj2mcjsq7sfsc0_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphm9o32cjh2bs) Dr. Prins says:
> ** "This chart tells you everything you need to know about the next crisis in America. In short, what we’re about to see is a currency crisis - but not the kind of currency crisis most folks expect. This firm - along with many others - will almost certainly go bankrupt as a result." **
According to Dr. Prins, our money is about to change forever... and the overhaul is set to happen in just a few weeks. To help folks prepare, she’s recorded a briefing that explains all the details of what she calls a 'reset' to our financial system. In it, she lays out all the evidence of this currency crisis, and what you can do to prepare. [Click here now to see her full (and free) presentation.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zibl12n1q1p1mvbkachuk6o4djg1t9agff6vvkeg_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphm9o32cjh2bs) Regards, Maria Bonaventura
Senior Managing Editor, Rogue Economics **P.S.** The last time we saw a similar transformations to our money, folks who failed to prepare were blindsided. But those who moved their money beforehand had the opportunity to multiply their nest-egg as a result. [Click here to see why.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9rmuk6bt136d1g7mr8bvgcl4ajqj6lpesb2v658_rp22sh2s8i66p72cphm9o32cjh2bs)

**He’s right** – he is vulnerable to defeat, and for good reason. Jon Tester represents a state in the United States Senate that Donald Trump won in 2020 by SIXTEEN POINTS.

Meanwhile, **Tester is in the United States Senate voting with Joe Biden 91% of the time.** I have a message for Jon: We’re running to represent Montana, NOT MASSACHUSETTS. _**

I know Jon Tester is vulnerable**_

_**Jon Tester knows he is vulnerable**_

****But unless you’re aware that this Senate race is one of Republicans' best chances to defeat a Democrat incumbent and flip the Senate, none of it is going to matter.****

We have a serious problem, friend.
2022 was one of the **deadliest years on record for honey bee colonies in the United States, with nearly 50% of these precious pollinators DECIMATED.** Beekeepers were left scrambling to help their colonies survive! This crisis was largely preventable – but greedy chemical companies keep flooding our ecosystems with bee-toxic pesticides for the sake of profits!
Neonics, the most widely used insecticides, wreak havoc on our bees and our planet. **But Big Ag still uses MILLIONS of pounds of these chemicals every year!** Chemical companies play such a huge role in our farming system that **even the seeds of our major crops, like soy, are coated with neonics.** That means the entire crop absorbs the pesticide from root to flower, making countless acres of our farm fields toxic to bees!
Sustainable practices like organic farming could help stop bee die-offs and protect the future of our food supply. But chemical companies have a powerful lobby fighting to keep control of our food system. Worse, they’re **spending MILLIONS on massive misinformation campaigns to deceive farmers and consumers** and suppress the urgent bee-saving solutions we need!
**It’s time to break the pesticide industry’s death grip on our farms and our future. It’s the ONLY way to protect our precious bees for generations to come! But we urgently need 14 more activists from your area to speak out before our National Honey Bee Day deadline at 11:59 p.m. tomorrow – but we're still missing your response! Tell us now:**

Beekeepers were left scrambling to help their colonies survive! This crisis was largely preventable – but greedy chemical companies keep flooding our ecosystems with bee-toxic pesticides for the sake of profits! Neonics, the most widely used insecticides, wreak havoc on our bees and our planet. But Big Ag still uses MILLIONS of pounds of these chemicals every year! Chemical companies play such a huge role in our farming system that even the seeds of our major crops, like soy, are coated with neonics. That means the entire crop absorbs the pesticide from root to flower, making countless acres of our farm fields toxic to bees! Sustainable practices like organic farming could help stop bee die-offs and protect the future of our food supply. But chemical companies have a powerful lobby fighting to keep control of our food system. Worse, they’re spending MILLIONS on massive misinformation campaigns to deceive farmers and consumers and suppress the urgent bee-saving solutions we need! It’s time to break the pesticide industry’s death grip on our farms and our future. It’s the ONLY way to protect our precious bees for generations to come! We are living through the darkest chapter of American history.

There were many times when the cause of our Founding Fathers looked bleak. The odds were certainly not in their favor.
They were standing up to the largest empire the world had ever seen.
Imagine if in 1775, the Founders decided that their mission was impossible and so they dropped to their knees and surrendered their noble quest for freedom. America never would've existed.
But they didn't give up. Because they embodied that age-old adage: "_I 'd rather die on my feet than live on my knees."_
The truth is: nothing great in life ever comes easily - _and what could be greater than reclaiming our American Independence from a corrupt, self-serving regime that attempts to imprison its opposition?_
**When I chose to run against the ruling class as a complete political outsider, I knew what I was getting myself into.**
I knew that the Deep State would use the full weight of the federal government to try and take me down.
_But the Deep State made one massive mistake ..._
...They didn't realize that they wouldn't just have to take _me_ down, but the millions and millions of hardworking Americans who refuse to surrender our country as well.

Together, we have defied every narrative, we have outsmarted the so-called experts, and we have _trumped_ the special interest globalist donors.
So, let me once again say to all our haters and enemies who want to put me BEHIND BARS for the rest of my life as an innocent man -_**I WILL NEVER SURRENDER OUR MISSION.**_
We will prevail against these vicious witch hunts.

| | Derek,

**An important milestone. ****
**
I'm extremely proud to announce that earlier this month Granite Solutions received our 200th Donation!

Thank you to all who have contributed to the cause so far and for all those who will contribute in the future. The funds we raise now will be used to expand our majorities in the State House in 2024. If you can contribute to the cause, [please do so securely here!](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fwww.granitesolutions.org%2Fdonate/1/0100018a08868a84-263e5628-81c2-41c6-beaa-8a7d3bf3d5ce-000000/qpQbNMrnF5_GiAZlS00ZQCIOsgU=335)

**Hampton Republicans are Energized for 2024!**

On Wednesday I spoke with the Hampton Republican Town Committee led by David Hagen. David is a great local chairman who understands the importance of organizing and winning locally in order to have a larger impact statewide. Hampton is right in the target zone, and with 5 House Seats representing Hampton a critical target district for our 2024 efforts.

As I told the Hampton Republicans, a good campaign is like a good barstool with four solid legs. High Quality Candidates, Hard Working Volunteers, Financial Support, and a Good Plan. We can't win if we don't plan and we can't plan if we don't organize. It may seem simple, but that's really all there is to it.

**Democrats Would Make New Hampshire a Sanctuary State****
**
As a simple reminder, 100% of New Hampshire House Democrats voted to allow sanctuary cities in New Hampshire just this past spring.

If they were to take control of the New Hampshire House, they would vote to make New Hampshire a Sanctuary State. I'm dedicated to making sure that never happens and that the New Hampshire House and Senate stays in Republican hands to keep New Hampshire moving in the right direction.

**Granite Solutions 2023 Summit****
**
Join us for an impactful day of learning and growth at the New Hampshire Institute of Politics (NHIOP) on Saturday, September 23rd. This candidate & activist training is designed for those who are passionate about shaping the future of the Granite State. From field organizing to social media use, our expert panelists and presenters will guide attendees through various essential topics.

From field organizing to social media use, our expert panelists and presenters will guide attendees through various essential topics. Whether you're a seasoned candidate or a budding activist, this training will equip you with the tools and knowledge to make a difference in your community.

Event Partners and Sponsors will be announced as we get closer to the event. [You can RSVP here.](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fopenwith.link%2FGraniteSolutions.org%2Fevents%2F1830.html/1/0100018a08868a84-263e5628-81c2-41c6-beaa-8a7d3bf3d5ce-000000/EiwZKwHnzkXMBfsDzc092m7lmYM=335)

Best,

Rep. Joe Sweeney
Chairman, Granite Solutions

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

subject: Preventing Election Chaos, RITE pushing for law-based elections in KS, WI, and FL
body:

| Election law litigation has no offseason. RITE is active in a half-dozen states confronting activists trying to bring chaos to the ballot box. Read more about our efforts in Kansas, Wisconsin, and Florida. ⬇️ ⬇️ ⬇️
---
|
---
|
# **For Elias, it’s the Dollar, not Democracy **
RITE President and CEO, Derek Lyons is out with an op-ed in the Federalist about RITE's mission and what's at risk if well-funded liberal lawyers, like still-empowered Marc Elias, succeed.

**[_The Federalist: _](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=c0e729666f&e=ea91f782ea)**

_Unfortunately, the left’s never-ending onslaught of activist litigation is far more harmful to our country than most get-rich-quick schemes. These lawsuits undermine the strength of our democratic institutions. They leave our elections exposed to manipulation and mistake. They cause people to believe a false tale about our states being run by racist politicians and election administrators. And they deprive citizens of the very popular electoral safeguards they themselves say to provide the assurances needed to trust our elections. _

Click **[HERE](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=34968eb883&e=ea91f782ea)** to read the column at The Federalist.

# **RITE Backs Laws to Prevent Chaos in Kansas Elections **

RITE is working alongside Kansas to undo a federal court ruling that struck down a commonsense rule that requires able-bodied applicants to fill out their own voter registration forms. The court said the law violated the First Amendment. House Bill 2332, passed by the Republican-controlled Legislature in 2021, prohibited outside groups from mailing voters pre-filled applications for a mail ballot. These pre-filled ballots are too often riddled with errors and infuse confusion and distrust into Kansas's elections, not to mention the work they add to local officials who must deal with an onslaught of voter questions and re-sending applications. In an **[amicus brief, RITE argues](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=aaa3dc6cfd&e=ea91f782ea)** that the ban on third parties sending pre-filled advance ballot applications to voters is perfectly lawful (and has absolutely nothing to do with the First Amendment). The state has legitimate interests in avoiding voter confusion, facilitating efficient election administration, enhancing public confidence in the process and deterring voter fraud. RITE was mentioned in the [**Topeka Capital-Journal** ](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=5100168e91&e=ea91f782ea)write-up of the appeal.

# **In Wisconsin, RITE Takes a Stand Against Activists Trying to Manipulate Vote by Mail **

Priorities USA, represented by the Elias Law Group, is trying to invalidate three democratically enacted laws regulating absentee voting. The laws require a witness to certify that the absentee ballot was filled out by the voter, prohibit drop boxes, and require errors on absentee ballot envelopes to be fixed by the time polling places close on election day. Activists implausibly argue that these laws, which only address absentee ballots and leave Wisconsin’s polling place voting untouched, infringe on the right to vote. RITE is defending the safeguards because states have not only the right but the duty to regulate absentee voting and prevent the unlimited chaos that would attend unregulated at-home voting. **[LEARN MORE](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=4d2a7ccfab&e=ea91f782ea)**.

# **RITE opposes DOJ’s twisted interpretation of 1964 law, which would all but eliminate a state’s ability to regulate its own elections **

In Florida, the Republican Party of Pasco County, supported by RITE PAC, submitted a brief in opposition to the U.S. Department of Justice's misinterpretation of the Civil Rights Act. According to DOJ, Florida and many other states violate the civil rights of their citizens by enforcing valid, constitutional statutes that require them to physically sign their voter registration applications. This is true even though Florida citizens who have failed to properly sign have ample opportunity to correct that error and can avoid the requirement altogether by registering at the DMV.

DOJ opining in Florida means it will likely continue to press its misinterpretation in courts throughout the nation. As RITE has argued, the Civil Rights Act protects against state officials denying people their right to vote. It does not displace valid state statutes that uniformly and reasonably regulate the electoral process. **[READ THE BRIEF](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=f6feb57707&e=ea91f782ea).**

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

# Empowering
# Overlooked Communities
|
---
I hope you're well and filled with the spirit of positive change.
I'm excited to share my vision for our communities, one that we can achieve together.
It's about more than jobs; it's about nurturing careers that ignite growth and align with aspirations.
Too often, certain communities are overlooked and left without the resources they deserve.
I'm passionate about ensuring that every corner of our communities have access to these meaningful opportunities.
| [LEARN MORE](https://alfonsoforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bb75364011dcc8a637f1fdd6f&id=11be341784&e=16d812e81c)

# Empowerment Beyond Boundaries
|
---
Our mission is to break down barriers that have held back certain areas from their full potential for far too long.
By focusing on quality education, fostering local entrepreneurship, and advocating for change, we can turn the tide and bring a new era of progress.
By contributing to our cause, you're directly participating in shaping a future where every community thrives.
Whether you've been following our journey or are new to our cause, your involvement matters.
Be a part of this movement for change, and let's build a legacy of empowerment together.

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12e0ec4b4f8b482c87afd48a054e2698&_e=6v527A_i7w49ff6aznR5OJOtlAmzavo_DkFQz0H7le6aAVJSKWiQfpsKYTJkJaT6MwRGcYqQYVEwgMbIjA-IhZP0_ofprGdt9pQ67EhOfMOvmvFKMgyxBQ0oigCSjtdLsc4Aoy4-qYnrfGkNg265xbrOaO3G3b9Fnu36R5fnyhfysMxGdMWYkKsA_R6HiCqOsBqkVb5ZPxi84Vw9uqD5dm-2b2CHvOj3n5pEhTN0u8zKJ9IuPNu-N7I5j7pTOBB1I1lSI3uhe3DYN5FecKMJBOQEIY_bebgviTVEYSXpYfUE6vpk1SA67o5xv1hNjvB79PNJSR-Bfxwvl37U77zY1sbONHG82aPY0YD3WRB0m1AfqIaULeXdBGADtgGwW9zfD-QFuQ0dAgDVi1rKxYSzUuaW8Zu9lNVtPsoNYByMvfQ%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=12e0ec4b4f8b482c87afd48a054e2698&_e=6v527A_i7w49ff6aznR5OJOtlAmzavo_DkFQz0H7le6aAVJSKWiQfpsKYTJkJaT6MwRGcYqQYVEwgMbIjA-IhZP0_ofprGdt9pQ67EhOfMOvmvFKMgyxBQ0oigCSjtdLsc4Aoy4-qYnrfGkNg265xbrOaO3G3b9Fnu36R5fnyhfysMxGdMWYkKsA_R6HiCqOsBqkVb5ZPxi84Vw9uqD5dm-2b2CHvOj3n5pEhTN0u8zKJ9IuPNu-N7I5j7pTOBB1I1lSI3uhe3DYN5FecKMJBOSPJ1ZeVzfpZstCCa1qBuDn_9H7JVuJJYwN6iiWAEnIy5m1LTdsKsAQAAydoqFvW9hHzlmoOZ9VTOSRB7RqzkcrD7AcTKSZuvEgeriwpowy6boPR7dx5L-oaDnQW2EI_bxiah-UWjgSPr-sHGzc394%3D) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

When I was growing up in the Dominican Republic, I never imagined that the American dream would allow me to become the President of the Providence City Council, or Lieutenant Governor – let alone have the opportunity to become the first Afro-Latina in Congress. I came to this country when I was 20 without knowing any English. Those first few years were tough on all of us, but I took my parents’ values of hard work, determination, and persistence to learn the language, go to college, start a family, and dedicate my career to public service. Now, nearly three decades later, I’ve gone from working on factory floors to being the first Black woman to hold statewide office in Rhode Island. Now, I have the opportunity to make history again, as the first Afro-Latina ever elected to Congress. I owe everything to my family and supporters like you. name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Lincoln’s secret weapon
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills

| This sponsored message from Defending the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f035a68f81294c72b028e2ddf777a089&_e=mrTCD-l39bxFxBZ-1tUcgQU5kle1Oop2HhtscNdqIo_Jw-TODutk5QZrb1aOsEAYoQxTV9JjKXecqd10sv1hvqXyrzthACOZwOxu12vZsQOEy-VKMAVibcrqFaFiu8i2ixmLgHfZP4jee8yvVsCx6GZfT4kdDlX9M0h5t8TEtlTT4sNsfc0q8o4OTMaMPSrRp8Zj3xo0d6UR-rUh7fci50-wjtzyRHoqTyfo8VOTEjXZOYYbCZcf34j8ePEjSqkXcAHEIJEs5ksLCPldJOQ7zYjDmsWTh7vHtvFjjvd19R7owV0NWabvgU9qy3qY31E1LQ_lMI1Fd9Q0zdOC4r70_UZk8W2Oe8nZqAz4607SpNKWoy6dNfa7m-E4TZNNsmwXu9cUdXedR2bR4eOW2xdEyvobZZjLsZSqC11295lwg38%3D)
---
| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father's cabin, and did not return until he could "give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight."
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That's why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **" Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry." **
Through** "Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,"** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** ** ** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---
| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f035a68f81294c72b028e2ddf777a089&_e=mrTCD-l39bxFxBZ-1tUcgQU5kle1Oop2HhtscNdqIo_Jw-TODutk5QZrb1aOsEAYoQxTV9JjKXecqd10sv1hvqXyrzthACOZwOxu12vZsQOEy-VKMAVibcrqFaFiu8i2ixmLgHfZP4jee8yvVsCx6GZfT4kdDlX9M0h5t8TEtlTT4sNsfc0q8o4OTMaMPSrRp8Zj3xo0d6UR-rUh7fci50-wjtzyRHoqTyfo8VOTEjXZOYYbCZcf34j8ePEjSqkXaX6vKDruZAHd95eU3sK0c5gSrxUy8XenG7QvTOeMtiOKCVwoEM8_fcUQFl_siQl-SQAWkzj-vXceW_A_koCrATqIES5YqgK_5fwQ9AH4h3DsX6t30BtndI1yfT87ErCSpeiMJEVQnT2UkcTxnoLH0lujDWZFLi8JOZ9SyiYr-l0%3D)
---
| | That's why we need the support of friends like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.
Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I've included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f035a68f81294c72b028e2ddf777a089&_e=mrTCD-l39bxFxBZ-1tUcgQU5kle1Oop2HhtscNdqIo_Jw-TODutk5QZrb1aOsEAYoQxTV9JjKXecqd10sv1hvqXyrzthACOZwOxu12vZsQOEy-VKMAVibcrqFaFiu8i2ixmLgHfZP4jee8yvVsCx6GZfT4kdDlX9M0h5t8TEtlTT4sNsfc0q8o4OTMaMPSrRp8Zj3xo0d6UR-rUh7fci50-wjtzyRHoqTyfo8VOTEjXZOYYbCZcf34j8ePEjSqkXDi70pmhQ_q41krpHYBJvPlq3tudqa0ugk21vlrO0QTfhFOE8LVL-6vNDQQiVTp-OQ3caGF8S6bUCL9AmVhJIfUCVNnkjP7rDBwXKAsotmkczwIScIxUoNvHHoWJmnP8rLmQkp5MJt9YDwCT3jsiSV-L6txosnycISFdOdjzicro%3D)
Thank you for partnering with Hillsdale in its mission on behalf of liberty.
Warm regards,
Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

NEGOP+ NEGOP+ not only provides you with a plethora of benefits but also plays a pivotal role in strengthening our party's presence in Nebraska. This exclusive membership is designed to offer an array of benefits to our supporters based on their chosen level of engagement. The benefits range from unique NEGOP+ Club Pins to private invites to our Chairman's Club Dinners with VIPs. Here's a snapshot of what you can expect from each membership level: BASIC LEVEL – BOOSTER CLUB For a yearly fee of $150 or $12.50 monthly, you get: A unique NEGOP+ Club Pin Access to exclusive NEGOP+ events PLUS LEVEL – VICTORY CLUB For a yearly fee of $300 or $25 monthly, you get all the benefits of the Basic Level, plus: An exclusive NEGOP+ high-quality tumbler/thermos Access to an exclusive quarterly Zoom meeting with me, the Chairman of Nebraska GOP PREFERRED LEVEL – CAPITOL CLUB For a yearly fee of $450 or $37.50 monthly, you get all the benefits of the Plus Level, plus: A choice from an array of custom local T-shirts An annual Zoom meeting or phone call with House or Senate leadership PREMIUM LEVEL – CHAIRMAN’S CLUB For a yearly fee of $600 or $50 monthly, you get all the benefits of the Preferred Level, plus: A private invite to our Chairman's Club Dinner with VIPs A stylish quarter-zipper sweater Your support is integral to the GOP's strength in Nebraska. I look forward to welcoming you to our growing NEGOP+ community! | Best, Eric Underwood - Chairman Republican Party of Nebraska | | "PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY" | | Copyright © 2023 Nebraska Republican Party, All rights reserved.

name: Andy Kim
subject: People need support in this fight.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
The opioid epidemic has crushed communities and families across New Jersey and our nation. I've talked to people on the front lines of this, people who have struggled with or watched loved ones struggle with opioid and other substance use disorders.

People need support in this fight. They need solutions.

It's time to move on from the stigma.

I've met with medical professionals, educators, and first responders who do the work every day to save lives, and it's clear there is more Congress can and should do.

That's why I reintroduced legislation to expand education and training programs for substance use disorder prevention and treatment.

We need long-term solutions. That starts with breaking down biases and spreading awareness. My bill opens the door for more inclusive and informed conversations about substance use disorders and treatment.

It's time to help our communities care for those struggling with opioid and other substance use disorders. I hope this bill can be a starting point.

Together we can work to end the stigma and find the solutions people need.

More soon,

Andy

body:
Now Mayor Woodward is in another competitive race against another scandal-plagued far-Left candidate, this time it's Lisa Brown. And we here at Shift WA are keeping a close eye on the race. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62154793:WvMJuqDKN:m:1:2610672541:7F3CA30FFDC8F9144EC239F88759846A:r "Shift Washington")
---
| Friends, In 2019, former award-winning broadcaster Nadine Woodward narrowly defeated Spokane City Council President Ben Stuckart to become the 45th Mayor of Spokane. It was a typical local government choice, as Councilman Stuckart had the backing of powerful liberal government unions, while first-time candidate Woodward garnered support from business organizations and community groups. Mayor Woodward's key campaign issues back then included the homelessness crisis and public safety, and pledging to establish a new police precinct in downtown Spokane. Shortly after taking office, the COVID-19 pandemic emerged, and she became an advocate for giving local officials a say in the safe progression of their communities, demanding more authority from Governor Jay Inslee. Now Mayor Woodward is in another competitive race against another [scandal-plagued](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62154794:WvMJuqDKN:m:1:2610672541:7F3CA30FFDC8F9144EC239F88759846A:r) far-Left candidate, this time it's Lisa Brown. **And we here at Shift WA are keeping a close eye on the race.** ** ** Our mission here at Shift WA is to shift the political debate in our state by highlighting the contrasts between conservative and liberal policies. As such, our focus naturally gravitates towards where the most action takes place - Olympia - and where so many statewide elections are decided - the most populous county, King County. **But our commitment to greater public awareness on key issues extends to our entire state, including cities like Spokane.** To continue our mission of shifting the debate in our state, we rely on the generous backing of grassroot supporters who share our mission. **_[We hope you'll consider supporting us today.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62154795:WvMJuqDKN:m:1:2610672541:7F3CA30FFDC8F9144EC239F88759846A:r)_** **_By donating, you actively participate in shaping the conversations that matter, challenging the status quo, and ensuring that key stories see the light of day. **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE:** August 18, 2023
Contact: [press@tellitlikeitispac.com](mailto:press@tellitlikeitispac.com)
**Round 9 Of Tell It Like It Is PAC’s 10 Reasons Donald Trump Is Afraid to Debate**
**ARLINGTON, VA —** Today, Tell It Like It Is PAC released the ninth ad in a ten-part video series highlighting why Donald Trump is afraid to commit to the first Republican National Committee (RNC) debate on August 23rd.
Round Nine takes Trump to task for losing a few miles off of his fast ball. He’s [low energy](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=64d70aae54&e=d0a9afa930) compared to his past performances. Nobody can escape father time, and it has [caught up](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=b219883294&e=d0a9afa930) to Donald Trump. As Governor Christie likes to remind Americans, if Joe Biden and Donald Trump are the nominees, they will be a combined 160 years old on Election Day.
Most [Americans agree](https://tellitlikeitispac.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=104ed976cff8130153157fdb8&id=3d88b1e044&e=d0a9afa930) that Biden and Trump are past their primes and it’s time to move on.
The underlying message behind the digital campaign is clear: Donald Trump is afraid to debate because he knows that Governor Christie will bring the fight directly to him. Unlike the other candidates in the race, Governor Christie is not afraid to prosecute his failures and disqualifying behavior.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

Your early donation paves the way for 15 months of strategic planning, ensuring our victory over the opponent and the continuity of our America-First agenda in the House. | Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan. In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game. Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. body:

Peter – last week, Ohio voters delivered a decisive loss to Republicans who were attempting to make it harder to protect abortion access in the state.
Post Roe , Maryland has become a safe haven for abortion – which means we also have a responsibility to help our neighbors access the critical reproductive care they deserve.
I’m proud of the work we’ve done to protect reproductive health across the state, including the new Women’s Health Center of Maryland in my home district.
The new clinic is boldly serving patients from neighboring states who have been forced to travel long distances after more restrictive measures were passed to prevent them from seeking care.
Countless Marylanders are committed to continue protecting health care rights and next year, abortion will be on the ballot. You’ll get to decide if reproductive rights should be protected in our state’s constitution – so, I want to know:
Do you support codifying abortion rights into Maryland’s state constitution? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-osOp6ox9UCscDK5Lqoxpg2]
Take the One-Question Poll [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-osOp6ox9UCscDK5Lqoxpg2]
To me, it's a hell yes . Let’s codify abortion rights here at home, and in the Senate, I’ll fight tooth and nail to codify reproductive rights on a federal level as well.
Thanks,
David

Friend, The Houston Independent School District is facing a crisis that is negatively impacting the education and future of our children. As you may be aware, our district recently underwent a state takeover, and since then, we've witnessed a troubling series of decisions made by Superintendent Mike Miles. These decisions include cutting essential resources such as libraries and special education teachers, and an overall mismanagement of the district's resources. **Our students, their parents, and our dedicated teachers deserve better.** Libraries are not just rooms filled with books; they are the heart of learning and exploration. They provide a safe space for our children to expand their horizons, foster a love for reading, and develop crucial research skills. Special education teachers play a vital role in supporting our students with diverse needs, ensuring that no child is left behind in their educational journey. **Overall, while Superintendent Miles is catching most of this criticism, it is very important to recognize Gov. Greg Abbott’s role in this situation.** Abbott’s repeated abuses of power are dangerous not only to our educators and students, but to our entire state.
