body:
This is the biggest thing I’ve ever been a part of.
Hey Peter, it’s David Hogg, gun safety advocate and co-founder of March For Our Lives. Many of our elected officials can be described as one word: [**_Cowards._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286660/422563957/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) Our kids, our planet, our freedoms, our democracy — are all under attack by far-right extremists, from the State House to the U.S. Senate, who are willing to let children be slaughtered at school and watch our planet burn for their own personal gain. [**We refuse to back down.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286661/422563958/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) There were many who said after Parkland that we couldn’t change anything because we were just a “bunch of kids.” But we proved them wrong — [**we passed gun laws in a state owned by the NRA.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286662/422563959/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) There were many who said young people would never vote. But we proved them wrong in 2018 — _defeating more NRA backed politicians than ever before in U.S. history._ Then, in 2020, we defeated NRA puppet Donald Trump. [**Both of these victories enabled us to pass the first federal gun law in 30 years.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286663/422563960/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) There were many who said Maxwell Frost, March For Our Lives' first National Organizing Director, could never be the first Gen Z Member of Congress. [**But we proved them wrong, again.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286664/422563961/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) Young people have a habit of being underestimated — and I have a habit of scaring Republicans by proving that, while we might be young, we are _powerful._ [**That is why today, myself and Kevin Lata, Maxwell Frost’s Campaign Manager and 2022 Campaign Manager of the Year, are launching Leaders We Deserve**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286665/422563962/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) — a grassroots organization dedicated to electing young leaders to Congress, and especially our State Legislatures, across the country to help defeat the far-right’s agenda and advance a progressive vision for the future. Leaders We Deserve will work in partnership with a stacked Advisory Board, including Maxwell Frost, Justin Jones, and other influential leaders. [_**_Are you in? Split a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Raja so we can win back our country and advance a progressive agenda._**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286666/422563963/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) | **[Donate >>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286667/422563964/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=)**
---
Why is this important?
[**Despite making up 45% of the electorate, Gen Z and Millennials only hold 21% of State Legislature seats.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286668/422563965/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=)
Conversely, Republicans have made significant investments in down-ballot races, leading to the absolute assault on our rights and freedoms that we’re seeing happen across states — from abortion bans to taking away LGBTQ+ rights to repealing life-saving common sense gun laws put into place after the Parkland shooting.
Our political system is stacked against us, but incredible young leaders have fought back and beat the odds to get elected to office. It’s time to take more young people from movements like March For Our Lives and elect them to office to be the leaders we deserve. [**But grassroots support is what moves the needle, and it’s what we need from you today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286669/422563966/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=)
[_**Join us by splitting a donation of any amount between Leaders We Deserve and Raja today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286670/422563967/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=)
So how are we going to fight back against the 50-year chess game conservative special interest groups have been manipulating?
[**Leaders We Deserve will invest in young people, knock down barriers, and elect more young people to office. We’re doing this by:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286671/422563968/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=)
1. [**Recruitment:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286672/422563969/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) Identifying candidates who will have the biggest impact on their states (that's where the real work is happening).
2. [**Providing Day-to-Day Support:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286673/422563970/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) We’re helping campaigns build from the ground up and will work with them directly on fundraising, messaging, coalition building, voter contact, and volunteer recruitment.
3. [**Volunteer Network:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286674/422563971/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) Our grassroots volunteer army (that’s you, Peter) will have person-to-person conversations with voters all across a candidate’s district, advocating on their behalf.
4. [**Running Paid Media Campaigns:**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286675/422563972/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=) We’ll run well-funded independent expenditure programs.

But there’s a reason our political system favors those who are older, wealthier, and white — _running for office takes serious resources._
Which is one of the reasons I’m reaching out today. Young candidates aren’t seen as viable and often struggle to raise money. They have lower personal wealth and smaller donor networks.
[_**So I’m asking: Will you join our movement by splitting a donation between Leaders We Deserve and Raja today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68286676/422563973/1436957821?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_hogg_split_30_v1&amount=14&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MzE2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkM2IzZjhiMS1kYTNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=O7wjdf1q5NgSeyjXsOSmx8ZYeOXnya4UDNVSwG520Ao=)

The Maui Strong Fund is closely collaborating with state and county leaders, nonprofit organizations, and community members to get an understanding of the quickly evolving priorities. [**I'm asking you to contribute as you can to help Maui recover from the recent devastating wildfires. 100% of the funds raised will be distributed to meet community needs, and any amount helps.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68287753/422567744/-387557724?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2Y5MGU3OS1kZDNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ck7C0Meagc-GCSyqBNtQpTteJItlORhvzSFMiDYY--I=&emci=f47f2b83-dc3d-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=23f90e79-dd3d-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=7731215) In this time of terrible disaster, I will be standing with the people of Hawai'i to get them all the help they need in every possible way. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

name: Sherrod Brown
subject: We will win in November
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Democrats Win Seats PAC
body:
| Hi Peter– last Tuesday, Ohioans voted to stop an anti-democratic constitutional amendment aimed at making it harder for us to enshrine reproductive rights in our state's constitution. In doing so, they rejected special interests and made sure democracy remained where it belongs – in the hands of the voters, not the rich and powerful.

That’s why I’m in this fight, Peter, to give a voice to workers and families. I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. I spent summers working on my family's farm. Today, I live in Cleveland with my wife, Connie, and our two rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter.

**I’ll be honest with you, Peter:** Over the years, in Ohio, we've seen manufacturing jobs shipped overseas because of bad trade deals, prices skyrocketing as wages failed to keep up, and hopes for a comfortable retirement dashed. That's why I've devoted my life to fighting for the Dignity of Work – the idea that hard work should pay off for everyone, no matter who you are, where you live, or what kind of work you do.

**Every day in the Senate, I’m fighting for you. But I’m facing my toughest race yet, and I need your help to win.****_[Will you chip in $25 or more now – split between my campaign and Democrats Win Seats – so I can keep up the fight in Ohio and defend the Senate for Democrats?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68288822/422572869/606635186?amount=25&source=EM_NBI_dwspac_20230818_FR_1.1_0_6MO_brown_NA_NA_mmfr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzUwNGQ0Ni1lMDNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QoXfuvRQnlreJCuoUdC-_0hPQZ6Hd-oMMhYt6rfFiDI=)_**

Right now, Mitch McConnell and the GOP need to flip only two seats to retake Senate control – and experts at Politico say it could all come down to Ohio. Last year’s Senate race here was one of the most costly in the nation, and NBC News reports this one could be “even nastier and more expensive.”

**That's why I simply cannot win this race – and Democrats simply cannot hold on to our narrow Senate majority – without grassroots support from folks like you. As one of the most vulnerable senators in the country, I'm personally asking:**

**_[Will you please split $25 between my campaign and Democrats Win Seats to help us hit our midnight fundraising goal, power our reelection campaign to victory, and keep the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68288824/422572899/606635186?amount=25&source=EM_NBI_dwspac_20230818_FR_1.1_0_6MO_brown_NA_NA_mmfr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzUwNGQ0Ni1lMDNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QoXfuvRQnlreJCuoUdC-_0hPQZ6Hd-oMMhYt6rfFiDI=)_**

This is gonna be a heck of a fight, but with you by my side, I know we can beat the odds and continue making much-needed progress for workers and families. Thanks for being on our team.

With gratitude,

Sherrod | | ****_******[CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68288826/422572902/606635186?amount=25&source=EM_NBI_dwspac_20230818_FR_1.1_0_6MO_brown_NA_NA_mmfr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzkvMS84ODcwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzUwNGQ0Ni1lMDNkLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QoXfuvRQnlreJCuoUdC-_0hPQZ6Hd-oMMhYt6rfFiDI=)******_****

| | Friend, **Your utility—****PPL Electric Utilities—just tried to block critical climate action.** Last week, power companies made a choice. They could either support EPA common-sense regulations on power plant carbon pollution, or they could hide behind their lobbyists at Edison Electric Institute (EEI) who are trying to block these critical rules. Thanks to public pressure from folks like you, some utilities publicly distanced themselves from EEI's letter to EPA on the proposed rules. **Unfortunately, your utility chose to delay climate action and maintain support of EEI's dangerous lobbying effort.** Worse, utilities in almost every state can use **YOUR** dollars, from your power bill, to fund their shadowy lobbying efforts through EEI. **It's time to hold them accountable for that choice.****
****
[Tell PPL Electric Utilities to stop using your money to kill climate action and do what's best for our economy, our households, and our communities by supporting EPA's commonsense limits on power plants and leaving EEI.](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4759?t=3&akid=13639%2E53494%2EHFTirY)**

body:
The White House is sending a loud, clear message

| |
---
| | Friend, Joe Biden's White House just changed the requirements for a journalist to obtain hard-pass credentials. Friend, when I first met Kirsten Gillibrand, she was a young lawyer running for Congress in a district with more cows than Democrats.
Defeating a deeply entrenched GOP incumbent in a tough red district is no easy task. Truthfully, there weren't many people who thought she could pull it off. **But on election night in 2006, people everywhere learned to never — _ever_ — count Kirsten out.** (For the record, I'm proud to be one of her earliest believers.)
Since that first election, Kirsten has proven herself time and time again as a fierce, bold advocate for families around America. The minute she was sworn in as our junior senator, I gained an incredible partner. During our time serving in the Senate, we've worked together on countless pieces of legislation, secured millions in federal funding for vital social programs and proudly fought for progress as a united team.
**As Kirsten's colleague and friend —** _and as our Senate majority_** **_leader_**— take it from me: We need Kirsten's voice in the Senate.** But following a red wave in New York last year, Republicans are already targeting her seat for defeat.

As her first Q3 fundraising deadline rapidly approaches, we need all hands on deck. That's why I'm personally reaching out. [_Please, friend, will you donate $5 or more right now to help defend Kirsten's must-win seat? There are few people in Washington who work harder than Kirsten. During our last session of Congress, she expanded veterans' benefits, won justice for survivors of sexual abuse and cracked down on illegal gun trafficking. Together, we secured long overdue reforms to our military justice system — ensuring that our service members can seek justice without fear of retaliation. **Now in the new session of Congress, Kirsten is fighting to guarantee paid family leave for all Americans and _finally_ add the Equal Rights Amendment to the Constitution.**
Kirsten is getting the job done — and Republicans are taking notice. They know how much of a threat Kirsten is to their far-right agenda. That's why they'll do everything within their power to defeat her.
New York Republicans just celebrated their best election cycle in decades. Their extremist candidates flipped enough seats to win control of the House. Now, they're trying to defeat Kirsten to take back the Senate too.
I know that Kirsten has what it takes to overcome the odds and defeat whichever radical right-wing extremist runs against her — she's done it before. But Kirsten is counting on grassroots support to take on the GOP.** [_That's why I'm personally asking you to make a donation to Kirsten's campaign before midnight tonight. clean_body: | | | Friend, when I first met Kirsten Gillibrand, she was a young lawyer running for Congress in a district with more cows than Democrats. Defeating a deeply entrenched GOP incumbent in a tough red district is no easy task. Truthfully, there weren't many people who thought she could pull it off. But on election night in 2006, people everywhere learned to never — ever — count Kirsten out. (For the record, I'm proud to be one of her earliest believers.) Since that first election, Kirsten has proven herself time and time again as a fierce, bold advocate for families around America. The minute she was sworn in as our junior senator, I gained an incredible partner. During our time serving in the Senate, we've worked together on countless pieces of legislation, secured millions in federal funding for vital social programs and proudly fought for progress as a united team. As Kirsten's colleague and friend — and as our Senate majority leader— take it from me: We need Kirsten's voice in the Senate. But following a red wave in New York last year, Republicans are already targeting her seat for defeat. As her first Q3 fundraising deadline rapidly approaches, we need all hands on deck. That's why I'm personally reaching out. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = There are few people in Washington who work harder than Kirsten. During our last session of Congress, she expanded veterans' benefits, won justice for survivors of sexual abuse and cracked down on illegal gun trafficking. Together, we secured long overdue reforms to our military justice system — ensuring that our service members can seek justice without fear of retaliation. Now in the new session of Congress, Kirsten is fighting to guarantee paid family leave for all Americans and finally add the Equal Rights Amendment to the Constitution. Kirsten is getting the job done — and Republicans are taking notice. They know how much of a threat Kirsten is to their far-right agenda. That's why they'll do everything within their power to defeat her. New York Republicans just celebrated their best election cycle in decades. Their extremist candidates flipped enough seats to win control of the House. Now, they're trying to defeat Kirsten to take back the Senate too. I know that Kirsten has what it takes to overcome the odds and defeat whichever radical right-wing extremist runs against her — she's done it before. But Kirsten is counting on grassroots support to take on the GOP. = | | = Thank you so much for your support, = Chuck Schumer Senate Majority Leader | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, this is a
longer email, but I hope you’ll take a moment to read it.

In November 2018, on a small budget fueled by grassroots supporters like
you, Justice Democrats succeeded in helping elect four of the most
progressive candidates Congress has EVER seen: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez in
New York, Ilhan Omar in Minnesota, Ayanna Pressley in Massachusetts, and
Rashida Tlaib in Michigan.

All four are women of color under the age of 50 with diverse backgrounds
and lived experiences that fuel their desire to challenge the status quo
and fight for social, economic, environmental, and racial justice for ALL
people. None of them are beholden to the establishment.

Soon, they would band together in the collective fight for progress and
real, bold change in Washington. It started with an Instagram photo of the
four of them shortly after Election Day, posted by Alexandria with a
caption that read “Squad.”

[1]Photo of Ilhan Omar, Ayanna Pressley, Rashida Tlaib, and Alexandria
Ocasio-Cortez

Republicans, right-wing media, and conservative groups like AIPAC quickly
started to pay attention and wasted no time attacking these newly elected
Congresswomen. One day after Alexandria’s post, Fox News commentator Laura
Ingraham declared Alexandria, Ilhan, Ayanna, and Rashida “the four
horsewomen of the apocalypse.” The Squad quickly became the new boogeyman
of the GOP and a favorite target of Donald Trump.

Why? Because they were afraid of these four young, diverse women in power
united in their fight to make healthcare guaranteed for everyone, pay
workers a fair and livable wage, take bold and urgent action necessary to
address the climate crisis, make housing more affordable, reform our
broken criminal justice system, protect the LGBTQ+ community, defend
everyone’s right to bodily autonomy and reproductive freedom, and stand up
for the human rights of people around the world.

Once sworn-in to Congress in January 2019, the Squad got right to work.
Alexandria’s first bill was the Green New Deal resolution to create
millions of clean energy jobs, cut emissions, repair our infrastructure,
and address climate change head-on. Ilhan introduced the NO BAN Act to
repeal Trump’s racist and xenophobic Muslim travel ban. Ayanna introduced
bills like the CROWN Act to ban discrimination against Black women based
on hair style and texture. Rashida secured $3 billion in funding for home
repairs and neighborhood revitalization and $1 billion to stop water
shutoffs for low-income families during the pandemic.

All four are keeping up the fight for Medicare for All, a higher minimum
wage, student loan debt forgiveness, and the rights of people facing human
rights abuses here and abroad, including Palestinians.

They’ve been called the nastiest names, attacked for their ethnicity and
faith, and been on the receiving end of countless death threats, but they
made it clear: the Squad, and the progressive movement they represent, are
here to stay.

Through your support, Justice Democrats has since gone on to elect
additional members to the Squad, including Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman in
2020 and Greg Casar and Summer Lee last November, even when our opponents
were spending millions of dollars and the odds were against us.

Our organization is experiencing financial struggles right now, but with
grassroots contributions from people like you, we aim to get through this
and continue electing more progressive leaders like the Squad to deliver
the transformative change we deserve.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137145?refcode=em20230818-30429&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=30429%2E1203867%2EBI03f9 ]Will you make a donation of $3 or whatever you can afford
today to help Justice Democrats expand the Squad and elect the next
generation of progressive leaders in 2024 and beyond? We can’t do it
without you.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/137145?refcode=em20230818-30429&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=30429%2E1203867%2EBI03f9 ]Donate $3

We’re here today because of you. Together, we have forever altered the
political landscape and reinvigorated the fight for progressive change
across the country — and we cannot thank you enough.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas, Executive Director
Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1021&akid=30429%2E1203867%2EBI03f9 ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1022&akid=30429%2E1203867%2EBI03f9 ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20230818-30429-footer&t=1023&refcode2=30429_1203867_BI03f9&akid=30429%2E1203867%2EBI03f9

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1024&akid=30429%2E1203867%2EBI03f9

Because this White House doesn't respect the freedom of the press. **[Which is why I'm asking you for an urgent donation of $35 or more today to help fund Simon's lawsuit against the White House and Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=9ae168090de24f54b6b48818ceb2a7f2&_e=mVFlwpvaRRbmmryY5CbRNuFwO5rNTgU4XcjaPfVJWkIlKE_X_ZrGtUv5nUw9xevArTmHBpFF4Tg9baeo7KgPTnHZ78GtGBQOvDQxC84VR2Uor5ZBxbD248Wuac1vFTO7FYMVxY-Q001Cgx7wwePXSfJHfNKkL2F3psmSNbGH_LjFXaMT-rrrwbM4hxDbHOQCxJ9IlLpwQeRAiHpyapCXjSfSnofmWzCdYQZZyTtU5u8z577QbLLPZ-cV3yoog1Wt_PWrtu2pXjvderCckVyz9idYnzGhinRoGQC2bTsrJ07y_-fusq2OWs4PaMqlV_-_nGs0PN5d54lRCxtIYEWjCizeMKeVdH8DMP_56XMX3f9UUiOFQ2KiYJYjaLMSUIta)** This White House has a terrible record of censoring journalists whose stories make the White House look bad. The result... ...effectively banning our client, Simon Ateba, and more than 440 reporters from the White House Briefing Room. The White House is sending a loud, clear message: if you don't work for CNN, The New York Times , or another legacy media outlet, and if you refuse to mindlessly lob soft balls to Karine Jean-Pierre about Joe Biden's ice cream du jour, you don't belong in the White House Press Corps. Because this White House doesn't respect the freedom of the press. This White House has a terrible record of censoring journalists whose stories make the White House look bad. We all remember how the Biden Administration pressured "Big Tech" to censor journalists questioning the efficacy of the COVID-19 vaccine. Now, the White House is shifting its attention to our client, Simon Ateba. Simon Ateba is a journalist and White House correspondent with Today News Africa, a small a news organization focusing on ties and interactions between Africa and the United States. Simon frequently challenges Karine Jean-Pierre's non-answers, inaccurate information, and demands transparency and the truth. In response to Simon's insistence on getting the truth, the White House and Jean-Pierre changed the rules, I believe, to specifically target Simon and other journalists like him who want nothing more than to do their job as real journalists. That 's right - the White House rewrote the rules to shut out hundreds of hardworking reporters. And that's why we're suing the White House and Press Secretary Karine Jean-Pierre on behalf of reporter Simon Ateba. You and I know the White House's actions here are a clear violation of the freedom of the press. This is bigger than Simon or any one journalist, {\var:firstname Friend}. Because the Biden Administration doesn't just want to shut up Simon... ... it wants to censor every journalist who challenges the White House's lies, corruption, or abuse of power. We need your help right away. That 's why we've taken on Simon Ateba's legal battle - and why I hope you will step up and help us win this important battle. Simon needs you, our attorneys need you, and your country needs you. Thank you in advance for your support. | | Sincerely, Harmeet K. body:
The DNC can not save us. It is up to us! | Firstly, I believe the work the DNC is doing is important, it is just not enough. I believe in Sh
| | **Can't see this message?_[View in a browser](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/dfOe9TGcU/c?w=rm07JEIb_ift25RqQm5M7oZVqAQOYcFbsPtbSSuFOUs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucnVyYWxhbWVyaWNhbnN1bml0ZWQub3JnL3NvL2RmT2U5VEdjVT9sYW5ndWFnZVRhZz1lbiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9)_**
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | A huge "Thank you" to all the candidates that ran and are running.2023 are local races and all politics is local.
---
| | |
---
| | The DNC can not save us.It is up to us!
---
| | Firstly, I believe the work the DNC is doing is important, it is just not enough. I believe in Shasti Conrad and I think that Senator Murray is wonderful. Any actions I call into question, are more accurately the result of a flawed system. I believe that rural America must act as an independent agent and take responsibility to lift itself up.
---
| | |
---
| | Declining Democratic visibility and voice in rural areas has left us vulnerable to the far right’s incursion. Republicans have used this opportunity to fill the void with their brand of rhetoric based on lies, denial of science, historical revision, evangelical zealotry and restoring legal prejudice against minorities. Except for a few strongholds of local Democrats defending the counties and legislative districts, Democrats are, by and large, silent in rural communities. The national Democrats and national Democratic organizations have continued to focus on shrinking islands of cash and Democrat dense urban areas. We see this mirrored here at home in the last election cycle when Senator Murray’s campaign canceled their election stops in Central Washington. The campaign had the time and had the money, but they knew we weren’t going to bring more votes or money and so, in campaign logic, it is not worth the time. The negative impact on down-ballot candidates and Democratic morale was significant. The Washington State Democrats have an election year operating budget of over $7 million, but the amount spent in Central and Eastern Washington is in the 10s of thousands. Washington State is the 10th largest contributor to political races with two-thirds going to Democratic races. But in Washington State, virtually zero dollars went to Democratic races east of the Cascades. In fact, more money went to Republican races. This concept of measuring the value of constituents by the money or votes they can produce is antithetical to Democratic values and, if changes are not made, will cost us our democracy. Chasing sure wins, with the exception of all else, has resulted in GenZ, Latinx and union members in rural areas trending red. White voters in rural areas have shifted 19% toward the red. Two-thirds of all state Houses hold Republican majorities and we are watching in real-time the Republicans dismantling the rule of law and destroying the faith of many in this great nation. A staggering 80% of the people inCentral Washington have not heard apro-Democratic message! We in rural America know that the “truths” we hear in the progressive media are not always the whole truth. But they say the best lie has a bit of truth in it.
* GenZ will save Democrats. If you look only at Democrat dense urban areas and college towns, this seems to be true. But in rural areas like ours where 80% have never heard a pro-Democratic message, our future voters and GenZ are trending red.

* Latinx voters represent a large voting block for Democrats, which is true, except that this voting block is trending red and we can see the day when it will be majority Republican.

* Our city councils, school boards and community organizations are increasingly led by the far right, which makes it possible to shape policy that reflects their ideology and imposes it on us.

* Democrats are college educated and smarter and so, if more people are college educated, then Democrats will win. Our people are not dumb. We do noble work such as feed the nation, generate energy, build housing, care for the elderly and so many important roles. Making the statement that college education creates Democrats is spurious at best. 80% of the people in Central Washington have not heard a pro-Democratic message. Our schools are not teaching civics, banning books and many live in actual fear of MAGA violence. A college education doesn't fix that.

---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | [](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/dfOe9TGcU/c?w=azWnJktFGGjO8Zod_8yKoxBH_CTKpvVY0k9iRaUjaxc.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JhdSIsInIiOiJmZmZiYzAyYi0zOWQ4LTQyYWEtOWFmNy1kMGM2OTE0MTAxNWIiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ)
---
| | We know that geography, more than any other factor, separates Democrats from Republicans. Despite the win, the recent vote on Issue 1 in Ohio proved geographic importance. A precinct level look at the voting pattern showed that it was only the densely populated urban areas that voted “No”. The rural areas and even the suburbs voted “Yes”, showing the Republican's hold on rural America and further encroachment on our Democratic urban areas. We can look in our own backyard to see the same results. Central Washington voted for Loren Culp over Governor Inslee and Senator Murray’s loss in Central Washington was greater in 2022 than in 2016.
---
| |
---
| | All politics is local and it is where policy starts which is the Republican's greatest strength. Nowhere in the country is the power of local and state politics clearer than in Florida, where a despotic tyrant has made a mockery of our constitution and political system by willfully and easily bending it to his whim without the mandate of the people. This is the path that Donald Trump wants for our country and unless we turn the tide in rural America toward Democratic ideals, we could see a repeat of 2016. Urban centers are increasingly insufficient to hold back the tide of red coming from rural areas. The National Democrats' mission is to elect Democrats and that necessarily excludes deep red rural areas. Failing to act is cruel because it leaves so many to live diminished lives under far-right rule and unwise because believing that we can maintain supremacy and control rules of a few islands of democrats in this ocean of a nation all while we can see the water rising around us is absurd.
---

| | Tri-Pride was a huge success! Reaction from the Tri-Cities Diversity and Inclusion Council (TCDIC) was disappointing and a stark reminder of how the far right can manipulate the world we live in in cruel and dramatic ways. The TCDIC refused to communicate with us, or use their resources to promote or advocate for us. I spoke to one of the board members who, frighteningly, owns a diversity consultancy, told me that she was very influential on the board and personally would be doing nothing to support Tri-Pride. No member of TCDIC showed up for the event. However, we had great fun!
* Our fundraising was 500% over previous years.
* Doubled vendor participation
* Set attendance records
* Ran a Tri-City wide TV and radio advertising campaign
* At the end of August we will present the Tri-Cities Pride Festival with a check

body:
| I’ve been up and down California this past week meeting directly with Golden State voters about their concerns, their priorities, and the top issues that California’s next U.S. Senator must address.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3438%2E5257348%2E6NKSbB)
Derek, I’ve been up and down California this past week meeting directly with Golden State voters about their concerns, their priorities, and the top issues that California’s next U.S. Senator must address.
And one thing I continue to hear over and over again is this: **The Senate is broken — it has been for a very long time.** _And it’s only gotten worse with Mitch McConnell’s abuse of the filibuster for**years.**_
[**I’d like nothing more than the chance to meet and hear from you directly about what we need to do to fix the Senate and make progress for our country. So I’m hoping you can take a moment or two to complete our campaign’s Summer Priorities Survey. Add your response >>**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20230818-august-issues-survey.tfH9hk&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_SUR_AC90_20230818_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=3438%2E5257348%2E6NKSbB)
[TAKE THE SURVEY](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20230818-august-issues-survey.tfH9hk&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_SUR_AC90_20230818_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=3438%2E5257348%2E6NKSbB)
---
When we controlled the House and Senate, we did incredible things, like pass the _Inflation Reduction Act_ , the _CHIPS and Science Act_ , and so much more. But there were dozens and dozens of other key priorities that didn’t see the light of day, because Mitch McConnell buried them in the Senate.
Abortion rights, voting rights, campaign finance reform, and more were held hostage by McConnell’s abuse of the filibuster — a mechanism that exists nowhere in our Constitution and that Republicans have abused for years to grind legislation to a virtual halt.
When our institutions fail to produce, voters start looking for other solutions — **including to a demagogue who promises that “they alone can fix it.”** And part of the reason we have not been able to pass legislation to reinforce the guardrails of our democracy and protect us from such demagogues — like my _Protecting our Democracy Act_ — is due to the dysfunction in the Senate and abuse of the filibuster.
That’s why I believe so strongly that California’s next Senator must be a leader in reforming this institution to serve the interests of our country and its people — and that’s the kind of leader I strive every day to be.
[**But in order for me to best serve all Californians and folks across the country, I need to hear your priorities from you directly. Derek, take our Summer Priorities Survey for our campaign today.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20230818-august-issues-survey.tfH9hk&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_SUR_AC90_20230818_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=3438%2E5257348%2E6NKSbB)
Your time is so valuable to me. I sincerely appreciate your input — thank you.
— Adam

# _Announcing My Resignation_
---
Just a bit ago, I informed the members of the Indiana Republican State Committee of my intention to step down from my position as chairman of the Indiana Republican Party effective upon the election of my successor. Serving as the chairman for the last six and a half years has been a great honor and a privilege. Together, we have accomplished so much, the least of which includes defeating an incumbent Democrat U.S. Senator, flipping 19 mayoral offices and electing a record number of Republican mayors, launching the Indiana Republican Diversity Leadership Series, and just this past November, making Indiana as "red" as it has ever been since the 1950s. None of this would have been possible without the help of so many. Thank you for everything that you have done for our great Indiana Republican Party. I fully believe that if we continue to campaign with a clear message as Indiana's only Party of Purpose, and then deliver real results for all Hoosiers, that they will continue to elect and reelect Republicans long into the future. Thank you, again, for everything. You can read our full news release by clicking [here](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/282e5d04dcf81647/dcb1cf99eabb9f9ec3d6b838967d376c/40313).
---
---
Chairman Kyle Hupfer

# 🏛️ _Preserving Hoosier History_
---
---
| | _**Governor Eric Holcomb** participates in a groundbreaking ceremony for the new state archives building._**
---
This week,**Governor Eric Holcomb **joined other elected officials in breaking ground on the site of the new state archives building.
* The building will be the new home to Indiana's vast collection of documents and other records, including executive, legislative and judicial records dating back to Indiana’s territorial government of the 1790s, including the 1816 and 1851 state constitutions.

**What he's saying:** "We’ve heard a lot about this for a lot of years. Visitors are going to come to this place, and they’re going to learn so many things — maybe some surprising things ... fascinating things ... how we got to where we are ... it all illustrates that path forward, and where we’re going as a state,” said **Gov. Holcomb**. **Context:** Currently, these records are stored in a warehouse on the east side of Indianapolis that lacks the necessary climate controls since to properly preserve them.
* They were moved from the basement of the state library building during a 2001 renovation.

Read more from the _[Indiana Capital Chronicle](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/282e5d04dcf81647/21d4c3a80f0fe8fec3d6b838967d376c/40313)_.

# 👀 _ICYMI: Democrats Forget How They Voted_
---
---
The Indiana Democrat Party and Democrats in the statehouse seem to have forgotten how they voted on key bills this past legislative session. **Catch up: **Over the past couple weeks, the Indiana Democrat Party has attempted to attack statehouse Republicans on multiple issues, seemingly forgetting that their members voted against solutions to those very issues.
* On [child care](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/282e5d04dcf81647/4048ee60afa3f2c1c3d6b838967d376c/40313), all but two statehouse Democrats voted against establishing a tax credit to help expand child care across the state.
* On [clean water](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/282e5d04dcf81647/0a60d06acc0b8fc4c3d6b838967d376c/40313), all but two statehouse Democrats voted against a 500% increase for Clean Water Indiana.
* On[ Pre-K](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/282e5d04dcf81647/7909321004d3a011c3d6b838967d376c/40313), all but two statehouse Democrats voted against expanding eligibility for the program, making thousands of more Hoosier families eligible.

**The icing on the cake:** Democrat State Senator **Andrea Hunley** sent out a taxpayer-funded mailer saying she was proud of what "we" were able to accomplish this past legislative session.
* The problem? She joined all but two statehouse Democrats in voting against everything she listed, including funding for a homeless shelter, eliminating textbook fees, doubling the amount of funding for food banks, and creating an economic enhancement district for downtown Indianapolis.

**Statehouse Republicans are the ones delivering for Hoosiers.**

Peter,
In the wake of the disturbing events that unfolded in the aftermath of the 2020 election, the trial of Donald J. Trump has become a pivotal moment for our democracy.
The importance of this trial cannot be overstated – it's a defining moment in our nation's history. It's imperative that this trial is conducted transparently, in full view of the American public.
Major news outlets like The New York Times and The Washington Post, along with members of Congress, are calling for the televised broadcast of Trump's trial.
We have an opportunity to make our voices heard and ensure that this trial, which involves an attempt to overturn an American election, is broadcasted for all to witness. Join this movement by demanding Trump’s trial is televised! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-televise-the-trial-of-donald-j-trump?source=direct_link&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yyz_ja&refcode=baa_ja_televisetrumptrial2308&amount=15]
SIGN ON! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-televise-the-trial-of-donald-j-trump?source=direct_link&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yyz_ja?refcode=baa_ja_televisetrumptrial2308&amount=15]
We are asking Chief Justice John Roberts, who chairs the U.S. Judicial Conference, to make the crucial decision to allow cameras in the courtroom. By doing so, we can help ensure the trial's legitimacy and uphold the principles of transparency and accountability that our democracy is built upon.
Here's why this matters:
**Historic Significance**: The trial of a former president who tried to undermine American democracy is a historic event. It will be remembered alongside landmark cases like Marbury v. Madison and Brown v. Board of Education.
**Legitimizing the Outcome**: Televising the trial allows the public to witness the proceedings firsthand, promoting public acceptance of the jury's verdict. As Harvard Law professor Lawrence Tribe points out, trust in the rule of law relies on trust in its processes.
**Public Importance**: For many citizens, this trial represents the most significant activity their government will undertake in their lifetimes. It's a matter of accountability, justice, and safeguarding the foundations of our nation.
Your signature matters. Join us in demanding transparency and accountability in this pivotal trial. Sign the petition to Chief Justice John Roberts, urging him to allow cameras in the courtroom for the trial of Donald J. Trump. [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-televise-the-trial-of-donald-j-trump?source=direct_link&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yyz_ja&refcode=baa_ja_televisetrumptrial2308&amount=15]
Add Your Name! [https://actionnetwork.org/forms/sign-the-petition-televise-the-trial-of-donald-j-trump?source=direct_link&referrer=group-blue-amp-action&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yyz_ja?refcode=baa_ja_televisetrumptrial2308&amount=15]

About BlueAmp Action:
We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world.
We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits.
And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect: after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t.
When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.
Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.
So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia.
Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

This National Honey Bee Day, we are fighting back. Take action and rush a donation to help protect bees and our planet -- before it's too late. To help boost our efforts, _**a generous group of donors is matching gifts in honor of National Honey Bee Day, up to $107,000 -- but only until midnight tomorrow. **_ Because you are a critical supporter, we have given you early access to our special National Honey Bee Day match: | [SPECIAL MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1935726?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
We need bees, and we need you to help stand up for them. That’s because bees are dying at alarming rates. _**Hundreds of North American bee species are at risk of disappearing forever.**_ Even honeybees are taking big hits. In the past, annual colony losses in the U.S. would come in at around 15%. Now, they are reaching 30-50%.
Toxic pesticides -- like Bayer-Monsanto's neonicotinoids -- are among the biggest contributors to the massive decline of bees and other pollinators. We need to get these bee-killing pesticides out of our food system -- but we can’t fight the pesticide industry and save the bees without your help!
National Honey Bee Day is about renewing our commitment to putting our bees, other pollinators, and the planet over profit -- will you join us now and set the tone for this important opportunity?
**This National Honey Bee Day, bees and our planet need your help. Please, donate $27 or more before midnight and have your donation matched -- dollar for dollar.**

---
Scientists are sounding the alarm, warning us that the toxic way we grow our food isn't working. But you can still help save bees and other precious pollinators, and it’s more important than ever to do so before it’s too late!
Because here’s the thing, Friend: Bees help keep our planet healthy. They're ecosystem engineers who are pivotal in supporting thriving habitats for birds, insects, and mammals. And bees and other pollinators are vital for a whopping 75% of food crops, like fruits, nuts, and vegetables!
But it’s getting harder for bees to avoid toxic pesticides as their usage continues to increase year over year. These pesticides are used everywhere from backyard gardens to industrial agriculture. _**Bayer-Monsanto’s neonicotinoid pesticides are long-lived and systemic -- they can't be washed off our food.**_ These pesticides can kill bees outright or weaken them and make them more susceptible to disease.
And it doesn't stop there. Neonicotinoids have been linked to serious health harms, including birth defects of the brain and heart. **With Bayer-Monsanto's neonics linked to hormone disruption and other health problems, this could have disastrous and long-term effects.**
The corporate players driving this -- Big Ag companies like Bayer-Monsanto -- keep producing bee-killing pesticides for corporate profit, doubling down on their destructive path. The only way to stop them is together.
**Don't let Bayer-Monsanto keep harming bees. This National Honey Bee Day, make a $27 donation and help protect bees from toxic pesticides and ensure a future for our planet.** ****

We have a plan to save bees. Friends of the Earth runs strategic campaigns to eliminate toxic pesticides. We're pushing garden retailers like Home Depot and Lowe's and supermarkets like Kroger to get harmful pesticides off their shelves and out of their products.

body:

# My Daughter, Becky
|
---
Hey there,
This is Barbara Price–also known as Becky Edwards’ mom. I told Becky that I wanted to write to her supporters some things about her. Because I’m her mom, she said yes!
Becky has always been a hard worker. She truly cares about people and making sure they are heard. Whenever she goes to an event, she actually listens to people and their concerns. Wouldn’t it be great if we had more politicians like that?
When Becky told me she was running for Congress, I was excited for more people to get to know her. I was also a bit nervous because campaigns can be really hard.
I’ve been invested from day one: from gathering signatures, making phone calls, and going throughout the state to encourage people to vote. [**Now, I want to email to ask you to help Becky as well:** ](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=74164ba8c3&e=6484bb6dd5)
**1\. Vote!** If you’re in Becky’s district, make sure you return your ballot as soon as possible. **2\. Donate to Help:** Even if you don’t live in her district, [_you can help Becky with a donation._](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=b661212b45&e=6484bb6dd5) It will help continue to pay for all the costs of the campaign—campaigns can be expensive! **3\. Volunteer:** Join me in volunteering to help get Becky elected! You helped my daughter get on the ballot—now I’m asking you to help her win.
I’m proud of Becky and I’m very grateful that you’ve supported her.
Thanks!
Barbara Price Becky’s Mom

subject: Let’s bring steel production back home

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

The United States used to lead the world in steel production. From the very start of World War II, we provided rapid support to our allies and later ourselves. By the 1950s we produced over fifty percent of the world’s steel, providing jobs to over 700,000 Americans.

Not anymore. Steel mill after steel mill has been closed across the country, devastating communities like Lordstown, Ohio, and Johnstown, Pennsylvania. Where we once dominated the steel industry, we have zero top steel production facilities left. We went from being the world’s largest exporter to the world’s largest importer of steel.

https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=9xZUjwaOSJFQ5dv9j1ldOqLK1FWNJh2ybzjO25fpgV+PbE+5WK4BeIV73N64ZYUmqfvulMcYeW4J56OuhclSJvSF8uDFyVRsznnfHn/ZrfUi9UzUfrBgV2otKWoFLs49nKskiC9P/gUXPrNm4qMRew== [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=9xZUjwaOSJFQ5dv9j1ldOqLK1FWNJh2ybzjO25fpgV+PbE+5WK4BeIV73N64ZYUmqfvulMcYeW4J56OuhclSJvSF8uDFyVRsznnfHn/ZrfUi9UzUfrBgV2otKWoFLs49nKskiC9P/gUXPrNm4qMRew==]

It doesn’t have to be this way. We can begin to make steel in the United States again. And we can do it better and cleaner than China.

Sign if you agree: It’s time to invest in modern clean steel production. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=9xZUjwaOSJFQ5dv9j1ldOqLK1FWNJh2ybzjO25fpgV+PbE+5WK4BeIV73N64ZYUmqfvulMcYeW4J56OuhclSJvSF8uDFyVRsznnfHn/ZrfUi9UzUfrBgV2otKWoFLs49nKskiC9P/gUXPrNm4qMRew==]

I’m working across the aisle with my colleagues in Congress to introduce a modern steel act, uniting the federal government with steel companies and steel unions to bring cleaner, better steel manufacturing back to US soil.

That means creating thousands of good-paying union jobs. It means rebuilding the communities we left behind. It means producing steel using recycled materials and cleaner energy sources. It means strengthening our economy and working to restore the middle class.

Sign the petition: Tell Congress to invest in reestablishing the United States as a steel manufacturing powerhouse. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/steel-manufacturing-petition?contactdata=9xZUjwaOSJFQ5dv9j1ldOqLK1FWNJh2ybzjO25fpgV+PbE+5WK4BeIV73N64ZYUmqfvulMcYeW4J56OuhclSJvSF8uDFyVRsznnfHn/ZrfUi9UzUfrBgV2otKWoFLs49nKskiC9P/gUXPrNm4qMRew==]

In solidarity,
Ro

The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Celebrating One Year of the Inflation Reduction Act One year ago this past Tuesday, President Biden signed the Inflation Reduction Act into law. This marked America’s in fighting climate change and securing green energy jobs. The impacts on Indiana have been huge, but not a single Republican voted for its passage. The IRA is a ., as it capped co-pays at $2,000/year and made insulin just $35/month for seniors. It also offered historic tax credits for small businesses and families to install new heat pumps, solar panels and more. We need to keep spreading the good news of the IRA and the billions of dollars worth of investment it’s bringing to our state, all thanks to Democrats. Mayor Hogsett is Building a Stronger Indianapolis With 2024 Budget This week, Indianapolis Mayor Joe Hogsett his proposed budget for 2024 which includes over $320 for the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department, and large increases for the Office of Public Health and Safety to invest in violence prevention through the Peacemakers program and other initiatives. This budget shows what we can do when we elect Democrats. It is Indianapolis’ seventh balanced budget, keeping the city in a strong financial position. millions in community-minded public safety initiatives while giving police officers cost-of-living raises and funding for new equipment. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. This week we feature legislation from State Rep. Carey Hamilton (Indianapolis) to create a statewide climate change commission in Indiana. Rep. Hamilton has proposed such a commission during the last several legislative sessions, and will push for one again in 2024, Rep. Hamilton and Statehouse Democrats know how important it is to address climate change, and build resilient communities for the future. There is no time to waste to protect our air and water resources from extreme weather and droughts. Rep. Hamilton , “We’re hearing from the Indiana Economic Development Corporation that virtually every company that wants to come to our state is looking for green energy. # [Sign your name: Clarence Thomas must be held accountable for ethics violations! >> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf593c8d9-8165-4868-8ef0-a9f0ba7c95d0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Bombshell news stories have shown that Supreme Court Justice Clarence Thomas has been living a lavish lifestyle, bankrolled by billionaires and Republican megadonors – and recent reports revealed that it’s even more extensive than we previously knew. Gifts from Thomas’ wealthy friends (which have gone unreported in his financial disclosures) include “numerous flights on private planes, skybox tickets to sporting events, stays at luxury resorts, and a standing invitation to play at a high-end private golf club in Florida.” ([Source](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf3740efb-6685-471d-ba12-a1df3911838c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)) This is a gross violation of ethics and raises serious questions about Thomas’ ability to serve on the Supreme Court. He must be held accountable for his actions, and we must raise our voices to send a message loud and clear that this is NOT okay. Friend, this weekend marks 103 years since women were allowed to vote in the United States.
A century later, we're still fighting for the rights of women everywhere – and my extremist opponent Jim Banks is the one getting in the way.
I'm running for US Senate because I want people to have more freedoms than they did 100 years ago, not less. And I'm relying on grassroots support to help bring my vision to a reality – will you show your support and chip in today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_KP_react]
SUPPORT OUR TEAM [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/potts-email?refcode=20230818_em_fr_b1_KP_react]
Friend, I'm passionate about letting people live as authentically as possible.
But we can't do that if folks in Washington, folks like extremist Jim Banks, continue to put in the work to take our freedoms away.
Jim's well-known for leading the fight against Social Security, and not worrying about the millions of Hoosiers that would be left without life-saving benefits.
And we've seen how his commitment to taking away the right to choose has played out – Indiana's near-total abortion ban went into effect earlier this month.
Jim Banks doesn't care about equality: he's in the pocket of Washington elites.
Now more than ever, it's clear that something needs to be done, and that's why my team and I are getting to work!
But if we're going to outraise our GOP-endorsed opponent, we're relying on our friends and neighbors to show them the strength of our community-first message. Thank you,
Keith

Keith’s political work has been centered on issue-based campaigns and progressive candidates, with a particular focus on protecting women’s rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and the environment.
He is an arts advocate, having graduated in 2012 from the Boston Conservatory of Music with a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree. He works with local non-profit arts organizations, teaching after-school music classes, directing, and performing with organizations like the Phoenix Theatre, Indy Shakes, Indianapolis Chamber Orchestra, Actors Theatre of Indiana, and Civic Theatre. Keith currently lives on the north side of Indianapolis with his husband, Dr. Bryan Dodd, and their rescue dog, Mak.
