[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68312542/422634500/-1657784636?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZmFiMmYxZS0xYTNlLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GKc3EgjO9ChtsmjXalltdK0OwsMd_0PVZJZdUglhdN0=&emci=ae751645-093e-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=ffab2f1e-1a3e-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=11703046)
Peter, **103 years ago today the 19th Amendment was ratified, and our great American democracy was changed forever.** For the first time, women had the right to vote.

**But we cannot talk about the progress the 19th Amendment made without acknowledging the people it left behind.** The 19th Amendment only granted white women the right to vote, and women who look like me wouldn’t be granted our rights until almost 40 years later, during the Civil Rights movement of the 1960s.

The fight over our voting rights still goes on today. Just last week,**Ohioans came together to defeat a Republican-backed power grab that aimed to diminish the power of our vote.**

**And therein lies the truth of America, Peter – our democracy is a work in progress.** The American values of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness are worth fighting for – **but we must fight _together_ to achieve them.**

**I’m proud to have you on my team for the fight ahead.** Thank you for your support.

_Emilia_

But we cannot talk about the progress the 19th Amendment made without acknowledging the people it left behind. The 19th Amendment only granted white women the right to vote, and women who look like me wouldn’t be granted our rights until almost 40 years later, during the Civil Rights movement of the 1960s. Peter, it's clear that every vote counts, and every effort matters. I am so grateful for your support in helping me become the first Republican woman to represent Oregon's 5th Congressional District. Because of YOU, we made history, and I am committed to winning again in 2024. Can you commit to helping me on a monthly basis? | | | | My journey is rooted in community service and a determination to bring about meaningful change. From my humble beginnings on the Happy Valley Parks Committee to becoming the first Latina mayor in Happy Valley's history, I have learned the power of perseverance and the impact of diverse perspectives. In Congress, I bring these experiences to the forefront, ensuring that our district's voices are heard and represented. The bad news is that the upcoming election poses new challenges. We won by a razor-thin margin , and the Radical Left is determined to regain control of this seat. Their radical agenda threatens to undermine the values we hold dear and imposes a radical vision that doesn't align with the needs of our community. | Can you help me show them that we will continue to fight for our veterans, seniors, families, and the ideas that make our country exceptional? Thank you, Lori Chavez-DeRemer Congresswoman OR-05 | | | | | | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. _**It’s Patty Murray here. I wanted to make sure you heard that my friend Kirsten Gillibrand is running for reelection. Her message is below:**_
Peter, I want to personally thank you for always standing with me as we take on the toughest fights in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68312981/422636350/-1112368941?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk103-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NTQ2YTZhOC0xYjNlLWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VNA5v4trG_RdcrNugZb-P1rC18H2LHdXVjTzxMyoFxU=)
Thank you for having my back when we fought for **health care coverage for 9/11 first responders** and **expanded benefits for veterans** exposed to toxic burn pits. We must ensure that our heroes get the care that they need.
Thank you for supporting my hard-won legislation that **empowers survivors of sexual assault** in the military to seek justice. Together, we took on the Pentagon to win reforms that will create a fairer system for service members.
Thank you for never giving up the fight to **make gun trafficking a federal crime.** After _thirteen years_ of advocacy, late nights, whipping votes, my legislation was finally passed in last year's Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. Already, we're stopping the flow of illegal guns into New York.
Thank you for your continued commitment to family rights and gender equity. With your support, I have spent the last decade fighting for **national paid family leave** for all workers. And now, I'm proud to lead the charge to add the **Equal Rights Amendment** to our Constitution — which would finally give us the legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the country.
**My record is about winning real results for the families I swore to serve — not for corporations or megadonors. And none of that would be possible without your continued, tireless support.**
But here's the bad news: Republicans are emboldened after their historic victories in New York last year. **Now, they're laying the groundwork for an even bigger red wave in 2024 — and they're directly targeting my seat.** I'm relying on grassroots donors like you to compete with their right-wing megadonors.
**[Please, Peter, you've stood by me so many times before and I'm counting on you to have my back again. Will you chip in before midnight tonight to join me and Patty Murray in this fight for progress and defend our Senate majority?
